HOSTING_LATENCY_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the latency dimension: hosting.latency.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

latencyNonconforming.doc: unknown: the measured latency does not scale with rate as a conforming plugin's does (its scaling class is nonconforming), so its figure is not used

text.en: This plugin’s reported latency does not conform to what a host can use. Don’t trust its reported latency.

latencyParameterDependent.doc: conditional: the parameter sweep moved the plugin's latency; allowed where the host compensates, as it reads the live figure each cycle

text.en: This plugin’s latency changes with its parameters. Re-read its latency after a parameter change that could affect it.

latencyResolved.doc: suitable: the plugin's latency is measured and fixed (for a CLAP, the declared figure is what was measured at every declared rate)

text.en: This plugin’s latency has been resolved to a fixed figure.

latencyUnmeasured.doc: unknown: there is no latency figure, or the benchmark declared it unmeasurable; fails closed, never passed by default

text.en: This plugin’s latency has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.
